title: Family size bound
statement: For a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input with Fourier bound $s$ and learning parameter determined by its small-bias accuracy, its family-size bound is the value of the prescribed Fourier $1$-norm family-size bound at $s$ and that learning parameter.
hypotheses_covered: The input has valid small-bias parameters: $n>0$, $a>0$, and $2a\le b$
The Fourier $1$-norm bound is at least one
caveat: The defining family-size-bound function and learning-parameter definition are not included in the supplied upstream definitions, so their exact formula cannot be stated here.
